camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainTopClientIpVisit --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2019-10-01T16:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --SortBy traf --StartTime '2019-09-30T16:00:00Z' --Limit 20
description_en: Queries client IP addresses that are ranked by the number of requests or the amount of network traffic within a specific time range for one or more accelerated domain names. You can query data collected within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainTopClientIpVisit查询加速域名在指定时间范围内按照访问次数或流量排序的客户端IP排行，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-top-client-ip-visit --domain-name example.com --location-name-en beijing --start-time 2019-09-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2019-10-01T16:00:00Z --sort-by traf --limit 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopClientIpVisit

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries client IP addresses for all accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. Separate multiple region names with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，默认查询全部地域。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The criterion by which you want to sort client IP addresses. Valid values:

traf: by network traffic. This is the default value.
acc: by the number of requests
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：

traf（默认值）：流量。
acc：访问次数
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 20. The default value specifies that the top 20 IP addresses are returned
parameters.help_zh:
返回数据条目，最大值为100。

默认为20，即返回TOP 20的数据条目
parameters.name: limit

ClientIpList.description_en: A list of client IP addresses

ClientIp.description_en: The client IP address returned. Only IPv4 addressed are supported

Rank.description_en: The ranking of the client IP address returned

Traffic.description_en: The total amount of network traffic consumed. Unit: bytes
